title: Self-Host Upgrade Rehearsal
summary: Rehearse self-hosted upgrades and issue a customer-safe readiness receipt.
user: A small company offering or operating a Docker-based self-hosted product that must make upgrades supportable across unknown customer environments.
smallest_useful_product: A distributable CLI kit that validates a declared Compose or Kubernetes upgrade path in an ephemeral environment, captures config schema changes, verifies backup and restore, records required disk and memory, and produces a customer-safe readiness report.
constraints: Test artifacts must not include customer data.
The vendor supplies migration and health hooks.
Reports separate tested versions from unsupported environments.
